seoTitle: Biography | AI Transformation, Data Science & Business Intelligence — Ojobo Agbo Eje
seoDescription: Explore Ojobo Agbo Eje's career from management consulting and business intelligence to data science, published AI research, platform building, and AI transformation leadership.
text_003: I work across AI transformation and adoption, bringing together business judgment, data science, research, and hands-on platform development. My career has moved from consulting and business intelligence through machine learning to the organizational work of making AI useful.
text_005: Management consulting, training, and business intelligence.
text_007: Data science, machine learning, research, and platforms.
text_009: AI use cases, work redesign, adoption, and capability.
text_011: My foundation combines a Bachelor of Engineering and an MBA in Nigeria with work in management consulting, technology consulting, training, and business intelligence. Those experiences taught me to understand operations and decisions before choosing a tool.
text_012: Data science, research, and the public interest
text_013: I earned an MS in Data Science at Rutgers University and moved further into machine learning, applied research, and public-interest technology. At Rutgers, I co-authored work on the State AI Readiness Index and presented the team's research at the 2025 AAAS Annual Meeting. I also co-authored a 2026 systematic review of explainable AI in healthcare.
text_016: Today I connect that background to the questions leaders face: which problem is worth solving, which use case creates value, how work and decisions should change, what capability people need, and what practical solution should be built.
